headline: Emory & Henry shuts out Catawba on the road
dek: Emory & Henry went to Catawba and left with a shutout victory, extending its unbeaten season to eleven wins and three draws. After a goalless September meeting at Catawba and a home win in early November, the table winner took the rematch on the road.
displaced_by: Emory & Henry won at Catawba on Nov. 21 to stay unbeaten at 11-3-0.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry has scored 31 and conceded nine: the side at the top of the table got there by keeping goals out, not by outscoring the conference.

wire.line: Catawba outscored every other side in the conference and still finished behind Emory & Henry in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eight matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest at Flagler.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's loss to Emory & Henry left its season record at fifteen wins, two draws, and three defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mars Hill has scored 42 goals, more than every other side except Catawba, and conceded 26.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Héctor Vara has kept nine shutouts in goal for Catawba.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Charlie Clark has made 83 saves in goal for Newberry.

last_match.line: Emory & Henry remains unbeaten on the season after winning the rematch on Catawba's field.
